purpose: Keep media within a predictable proportional area.
avoid: The ratio does not supply a text alternative or image loading policy.
basis: Native source page 1098:924 (Aspect Ratio), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: The image alt conveys the meaningful media subject; a decorative image instead gets empty alt in its own context.
updatesAndDescendants: The wrapper sets CSS --ratio from a required number and rerenders children on prop updates. It does not load, crop, label or announce media automatically. This reference requires a finite positive ratio as a caller precondition.
referenceDecision: Positive ratio and meaningful alt are caller requirements. The upstream function itself supplies no runtime ratio validation.
